name: Angel Cunningham
title: Construction, Logistics & Office Administration Professional

Skilled in scheduling, dispatch coordination, inventory management, quality inspection, and equipment operation. Proven ability to streamline workflows, maintain safety standards, and deliver results in fast-paced environments. Strong communicator committed to efficiency, problem-solving, and team collaboration.
